name: Clown Formula
description: Four ingredients and a method, in the Church clerk’s hand — and, at the head of it, a word the Church did not have last week. Rozanne signs it out without meeting your eye.

name: Clown Potion
description: Brewed to the formula by the Church’s own dispensary. Drinking it is the easy part.

name: Magician Formula
description: The next rung, written out. Rozanne will not sign it out to a Sequence 9.

name: Magician Potion
description: Heavier than it looks, and colder than the room.

name: Faceless Formula
description: Three of its four ingredients are ordinary. The fourth is a name, freely given.

name: Faceless Potion
description: Rozanne hands it over without looking at you, which is not like her.

name: Warding Chalk
description: A stick of consecrated chalk. Draw the circle before you drink, every time, no matter how late it is. Carrying one halves the risk when you take the reckless route.

use.label: Check the circle
use.description: You draw a practice circle on the floorboards and walk it twice, correcting nothing, which is how you know you have it. Keep the chalk for the rite itself.

name: Copper Plumb and Thread
description: A diviner’s weight on waxed thread, taken off Welch McGovern’s floor. It is warm, it has not stopped pointing, and the Church has a number for it.

name: McGovern’s Notebook
description: His own stitching and his own hand, with one leaf cut out close to the thread and two words surviving at the gutter.

name: Mourning Ring
description: Jet and braided hair, out of the estate and unclaimed. Blackthorn will take it off your hands and not ask which estate.

name: Sergeant’s Key
description: Gorman’s key to the sealed rooms off Iron Cross Street, lent for the afternoon on the understanding that you were never given it.

name: Clown Formula (copied)
description: The same four ingredients in a stranger’s hand, on paper that has been folded too many times. Cheaper. Counts for the rite, and the captain will know.
patter: ‘Same words,’ he says. ‘Different penmanship. You’re paying for the words.’

name: Doubtful Reagents
description: Enough to brew one potion, at about the purity the label does not claim. Whatever formula you are working from, these will fill it. Blackthorn would not sign for them.
patter: He does not tell you where they came from and you decide not to develop a theory.

use.label: Brew it yourself
use.description: You spend a night over a borrowed burner with the formula propped against the sugar tin. What comes out is the right colour and very slightly wrong, and it will do.

name: Forged Warrant
description: A constabulary warrant with a real seal and an invented name. Good for one door, and only if nobody reads past the seal.
patter: ‘The seal’s genuine,’ he says, which is not the same as the warrant being genuine, and he knows you noticed.

use.label: Present it to the constable
use.description: Gorman reads as far as the seal, which is the only part that is real, and hands over the key without finishing the sentence he had started.

name: Set of Picks
description: Steel, worn smooth. Carrying them is itself an offence, which is why they are sold in an alley.

name: Bottle of Laudanum
description: Steadies a spirit body that has been asked to do too much. Everybody in this city is on it and nobody discusses it.

use.label: Take a dose
use.description: Bitter, and it works. The shaking stops and the room stops leaning. You will pay for it tomorrow, but tomorrow is a separate problem.

name: The Antigonus Family’s Notebook
description: Black boards, no title, water-stained along the bottom edge. Exactly as heavy as a book. Everyone who has read it to the end has died in the same hour, and it does not look like anything at all.

name: Marionettist Formula
description: The Marionettist rung, written out. Above Sequence 5 the Church stops calling these formulas and starts calling them arrangements.

name: Marionettist Potion
description: Made up to the Marionettist formula. Nobody signs for these.

name: Bizarro Sorcerer Formula
description: The Bizarro Sorcerer rung, written out. Above Sequence 5 the Church stops calling these formulas and starts calling them arrangements.

name: Bizarro Sorcerer Potion
description: Made up to the Bizarro Sorcerer formula. Nobody signs for these.

name: Scholar of Yore Formula
description: Four main ingredients and a procedure that reads like a citation: every step names the step it was copied from, back past the point where anybody was signing their work.

name: Scholar of Yore Potion
description: Colourless, and older than it can possibly be. Held up to a lamp it shows the lamp, and behind the lamp a room that has not existed for two hundred years.

name: Miracle Invoker Formula
description: The Miracle Invoker rung, written out. Above Sequence 5 the Church stops calling these formulas and starts calling them arrangements.

name: Miracle Invoker Potion
description: Made up to the Miracle Invoker formula. Nobody signs for these.

name: Attendant of Mysteries Formula
description: The Attendant of Mysteries rung, written out. Above Sequence 5 the Church stops calling these formulas and starts calling them arrangements.

name: Attendant of Mysteries Potion
description: Made up to the Attendant of Mysteries formula. Nobody signs for these.
